## Où j'en suis
The agent prepared the Terraform configuration for a blue/green PostgreSQL 17 upgrade on the staging analytics RDS and prepped the production environment behind a feature flag. A draft PR was opened with the staging plan, while production changes remain disabled pending extension upgrades and management approval.

- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman to 5.x on staging PostgreSQL 16.4 before applying the blue/green switchover.
- [prochaine-étape] Pick a production cutover window outside the 01:00-03:30 UTC dbt lock, after Maya's sign-off.
- [essai-raté] Upgrading the AWS provider to v6 triggered breaking changes, so the lock file was reverted.
- [décision] Pin the AWS provider to v5.82 to avoid v6 breaking changes in this PR (source: t04).
- [décision] Keep apply_immediately = false on production and defer the cutover date until Maya signs off (source: t14).
